note: Ten figures, nine tables and one uncaptioned variable glossary against 23 measured regions and 3 exclusions. The exclusions are one table continuation (Table 7, p15 to p16, no header repeat) and two outer panels (the right half of Figure 7's 3-D column pair and the right half of Figure 8's bar pair). Nine of the ten figures are drawings rather than plots: Figures 1, 3, 4 and 5 are one three-circle Venn template reused section by section, Figures 2 and 10 are box-and-arrow schematics, and only Figures 6, 7, 8 and 9 carry axes. The Venns are recorded as family other - no node, no axis, labels inside the circles, and the upper-right text is a leader-line annotation rather than a legend. Captions never mix sides: figures below, tables above, all twenty of them. The numbering splinters four ways ('Figure1.' glued, 'Figure 5.' spaced with a stop, 'Figure 6' spaced without one, 'Table 5' without a stop) and one citation glues its number to the word ('table7'). Two exhibits are never cited by number - Figure 2 and Figure 9 - and one is cited seven pages before it prints, Figure 10 on p15 pointing at the appendix page p22. Two coverage gaps are declared rather than patched: Table 8's Wellington block prints between its caption and y=562.3 pt with no measured region, and the four three-circle drawings carry their labels as artwork text that the text layer returns as body prose (Figure 3's caption runs straight into its first bullet).
rules: Nine of the ten figures are drawings, not plots: Figures 1, 3, 4 and 5 are one three-circle Venn template reused for one component set per section (recorded family other, since no node, axis or scale is drawn) and Figures 2 and 10 are box-and-arrow schematics, so the only plotted exhibits are the radar, the two 3-D column blocks and the bar pair [geometry.family].
Caption side splits by exhibit type and never mixes in this paper: all ten figure captions print under the artwork and all ten table captions print over the grid [caption.position].

The numbering never settles: 'Figure1.' to 'Figure4.' glue the number to the title, 'Figure 5.' spaces it and keeps the stop, 'Figure 6' and 'Figure 7' space it and drop the stop, and 'Figure 8.' to 'Figure 10.' return to the stop; the first four tables carry a stop after the number and Tables 5-9 drop it, all normalised to Figure N./Figure N and Table N./Table N with the printed form kept in the row note [caption.numbering].

Every numbered exhibit is cited exactly once by number in the prose except four: Figures 2 and 9 are never cited by number at all (deixis only) and Tables 2, 3 and 4 are cited twice, the second time together in one sentence on p12 [mention.count].

The citation style is the plain imperative 'pay attention to figure N' / 'we show it in table N' for fifteen of the twenty rows; only Table 8 quotes its own number as subject ('Table 8 shows ...') and only Table 9 and Figure 8 use 'as shown in' [mention.lead_pattern].

Lowercase 'figure N' and 'table N' is the house form; the single exception is 'table7', where the number is glued to the word, and the only capitalised citations are the three on p12 and the one on p17 [mention.style].

One exhibit is cited seven pages before it prints: Figure 10 is announced on p15 as 'More intuitive flow refers to figure 10(Appendix)' and appears alone on the appendix page p22 [mention.lead_pages].

The grids live in the model sections and the numbers live in the result sections: the indicator and plan grids sit under section kinds model and solution, the GRA table, the radar, the potential/rank tables and the performance figures under result, and the sensitivity curve alone under sensitivity [place.section_kind].

The exhibit that eats the page is Table 1 at 0.372 of the page and the one that eats nothing is the measured half of Table 8 at 0.037; no exhibit in the paper is full-page, and the only solo-page one is the appendix schematic, which fills 0.196 of its page [place.area_frac].
Exactly one row is extruded: Figure 7, whose two panels are both perspective column surfaces, and no other exhibit in the paper is drawn in depth [geometry.three_d].
Exactly one row carries colour bars - Figure 7, one bar beside each of its two panels - and no other exhibit in the paper prints one [geometry.colorbar].

Legends appear twice: the radar parks its key outside the plot on the right and the bar pair prints its key inside the frame below the bars. The four Venns look as though they have a legend in the upper right but it is a leader-line annotation, so they record none [geometry.legend].
Only two figures are multi-panel and both are one row of two (Figure 7, Figure 8), each panel returning its own measured box, so one row per figure carries one panel [geometry.panel_count].

The three indicator grids share one grouped layout: an outer metric cell spanning every data row, a group cell and its code spanning each block, and the tint applied per column and per block - not one table in the paper is row-striped [table.merged_cells].

Three rule styles: Tables 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 draw a rule between every column and the variables glossary does the same, Table 5 draws them inside its two header rows only, Table 1 draws a frame and per-row rules with partial verticals, and Tables 8 and 9 are booktabs - the rank table ending with no closing rule at all [table.rule_style].
Only Table 5 prints two header rows, and only because it groups eight metric columns under three metric names [table.header_rows].
Decimal alignment appears in exactly the two grids built from 4-dp grades, Table 5 and the measured block of Table 8 [table.decimal_aligned].
One grid breaks across a page turn - Table 7, p15 into p16 - and like every other broken grid in this corpus it repeats nothing: no header row, no 'continued' word [table.continued].

Only one caption names symbols: Table 1's parenthetical band prints G1, G2 and G3, and every other caption in the paper is a bare title with no unit, no condition and no parameter [caption.variable_count].
Figure captions run 5 to 12 words and are single-sentence titles; not one states a unit, a condition or a conclusion, and all are nominal phrases rather than active clauses [caption.words].
